decision: Stopped the remaining R5 confirmation after recorded baseline within-group CV already exceeded the fixed 2% limit. All completed and partial observations are retained; no speedup is established.
reason: Further R5 groups cannot undo a maximum-CV failure. A separate one-time R20 precision protocol will use the same nominees and unchanged gates; results will not be pooled.
interruption: SIGINT to wrapper; one active benchmark process group terminated; wrapper records interrupted status
